testo: Peek-a-boo! Surprise! Hi, I'm Max! I wanted to pop in to personally thank you for choosing our little project. I know what you're thinking: 'Wait, they promised this app doesn't communicate with the outside world and everything stays on my computer, so how am I getting a message?'. Rest assured, it's 100% true! No data from your home has left your device: this message was already hidden inside the program from day one, waiting to wake up today to say hi. Enjoy the app, and see you soon!
